notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl, browser UA) for all pages. robots.txt checked first - no Anthropic/Claude bot disallow, no blanket Disallow: / for User-agent: *; fetch tier unaffected. All requested pages returned HTTP 200; no blocks encountered, no need to escalate to tier (b)/(c). TREE: built from the homepage mega-menu (Textilien; Accessoires > Kuechenaccessoires > Kuechenaufbewahrung; Accessoires > Ordnung & Aufbewahrung; Outdoor > Outdoor-Textilien) cross-checked against sitemap_categories_de.xml. The sitemap revealed live Teppiche (Rugs) subcategories not shown on the parent page's own chip strip in a way that changed inclusion (Wollteppiche, Filzteppiche, Fellteppiche, Badvorleger, Laeufer, Kelims - all confirmed live via h1 match) and one Ordnung & Aufbewahrung subcategory absent from the on-page chip strip but live and h1-confirmed (Schluesselkaesten & -bretter). Sitemap-listed Tischtextilien child slugs (tischsets-untersetzer, servietten, tischdecken, tischlaeufer) all 301-redirect to the flat /kategorien/textilien/tischtextilien page, confirmed stale/merged, so Tischtextilien is recorded as a single leaf, not a group. QTY: JSON-LD ItemList numberOfItems field on each category page, cross-checked against the visible '<n> von <total> Produkten' progress-bar text where present (categories under 40 items show no progress bar, only the JSON-LD total); h1 verified to match the requested node/canonical slug on every leaf recorded. EXCLUDED: kategorien/accessoires/badaccessoires (278 products) - a mixed bath-accessories dump (mirrors, soap dispensers, WC brushes, waste bins alongside a handful of towels/bath mats/shower curtains) with no dedicated textile subcategory, so no clean qty is attributable to Textile without estimating a subset - skipped per no-estimation rule; kategorien/accessoires/wohnaccessoires (1808) and kategorien/accessoires/bueroaccessoires (89) - broad mixed accessory catch-all pages that duplicate items already captured in the specific subcategories above, not homogeneous Storage/Textile nodes; kategorien/accessoires/ordnung-aufbewahrung/papierkoerbe-muelleimer (33, wastepaper baskets/pedal bins) - waste receptacles, not storage/organization of belongings, out of storage.md scope; kategorien/moebel/aufbewahrung and kategorien/moebel/regale* (shelving/storage furniture) - explicitly filed by the site under Moebel (Furniture), excluded per the Storage Furniture Boundary rule (prefer Furniture when the site's own hierarchy places it there); kategorien/accessoires/dekoration/* (Wanddekoration, Vasen, Kerzen, etc.) - Wall Decor / Decorative Accessories, out of scope; the color-filter subpaths under Teppiche (weiss/grau/beige/blau/tuerkis/rosa/bunt/gruen) - facet/filter landing pages, not genuine subcategories, excluded per View-All/filter-page rule. Parent nodes Textilien (648 total), Teppiche (302 total) and Ordnung & Aufbewahrung (320 total) are not recorded with their own qty/link because each has recorded live subcategories (Parent Category URL Rule) - they appear only as grouping rows. No duplicate records; no quantities estimated or aggregated; no product-detail/search/collection URLs used.
